source_review.notes: Checked current Trino, Spark, PostgreSQL, DataFusion, DuckDB, and Calcite join/planner documentation plus primary F1 Query, Presto, and MapReduce sources. All thirteen cited URLs returned HTTP 200. Product behavior is attributed and algorithmic guidance states semantic, statistical, resource, and recovery assumptions.

evidence: Reviewed input bags R/S, join keys, residual predicate, partitions, hash version, partition count, and owner function.
Reviewed per-key multiplicities, build bytes, hash amplification, destinations, and worker memory.
Checked union, Cartesian multiplicity, modular routing, positive counts, estimates, and units.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Ordinary equality, null-safe equality, ordering comparison, and residual qualification remain distinct.

evidence: Executed the Python 3 fixture and reproduced four duplicate-key matches and zero ordinary-equality null matches.
Recomputed the compact example as two build rows times two probe rows for key 1, yielding four pairs.
Recomputed Exercise 1 as 15 ordinary-equality pairs and 39 null-safe pairs.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Counts are before residual filtering and are explicitly scoped to bag semantics.

evidence: Verified compatible unique partition routing makes the union of local equality joins complete without cross-partition duplicates.
Verified equal-key runs contribute m_R(a)*m_S(a) candidate pairs under bag semantics.
Verified a Bloom filter with no false negatives can prune definite absence but cannot prove positive join membership.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Partition correctness, local join semantics, balance, memory fit, and recovery are separate claims.
